items.title: Samurai or Merchant?
items.task: Compare these wooden shop-houses with Kanazawa’s walled lanes. Who showed off here?

items.title: Why Is Everything Wood?
items.task: Look up. Forests, carpenters, fire risk. Why wood anyway?

items.title: Tokyo's Office in the Mountains
items.hook: The shogun’s office, far from Edo.
items.reveal: A magistrate’s compound. Why keep one here? Check the motive before live.
items.notes: TAK-04 Government Without Computers is cut.

items.title: A Market More Than 300 Years Old
items.task: If the morning market is on, look. Do not require a shopping challenge.

items.title: The Faceless Doll
items.task: Find a sarubobo. What is missing?
items.reveal: A face. The blank is part of the charm tradition. Check the luck story before live.
items.notes: Confirm faceless-doll / protection tradition. Avoid overclaiming the name origin.

items.title: Baby Monkey?
items.task: The name can be read as baby monkey. A light leftover, not a zoology lesson.

items.title: This Is Not a Car
items.task: Find a festival float, in a hall or a storehouse. It is a yatai, not a truck.

items.title: Robots Before Electronics
items.reveal: Karakuri are clockwork theatre. Do not say they caused modern robots.
items.notes: TAK-11 Anime Was Here is cut.

items.title: Hida Beef Test
items.task: If you eat it, predict: sweet, fatty, mild?

items.title: Mitarashi Surprise
items.task: If you meet mitarashi dango, guess: only sweet, or also savoury soy?
